seoDescription: Market analysis, benchmarking and brand strategy for businesses that already have a good product and can't explain it. Valencia, Spain.

hero.text: I read the market, the competition and the audience so a brand can stop improvising what it says.

duo.text: Market analysis and entry into specialist retail. The product was good; what was missing was a reason to pay what it cost.

items.name: Market analysis
items.text: Real market size, current trends and the gap that is actually open, with every source cited.

items.name: Benchmarking
items.text: Who really competes, what they are saying, and where there is ground to take.

items.name: Social media audit
items.text: What is being published, what works, and what can stop tomorrow morning.

items.name: Audience & SWOT
items.text: Who we are talking to and from what position, with the weaknesses written down plainly.

items.name: Objectives & KPIs
items.text: What we are chasing, by when, and the number that will say whether it worked.

bio: Six years in brand positioning, first in an agency and since 2023 on my own. I work with small brands that already have a good product and cannot explain it.
I come from analysis, not from design. Every project ships with the sources and the numbers in plain sight, so the client can defend it without me in the room.

contact.text: Tell me where your brand is stuck. I reply within 48 hours.
